records.literal_gloss: I love, because YHWH hears my voice, my pleas.

en.L: I love [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}], because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} hears my voice, my pleas.
en.B: I love {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} listens when I call to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and plead for mercy.
en.R: I love {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} hears me when I pray and ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for help.

fr.L: J’aime [{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}], car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} entend ma voix, mes supplications.
fr.B: J’aime {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} écoute quand je {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appelle et que je {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} supplie.
fr.R: J’aime {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’entend quand je prie et que je {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demande de l’aide.

sw.L: Nampenda, kwa kuwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} husikia sauti yangu, dua zangu.
sw.B: Nampenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana husikiliza ninapomwita na kumsihi anihurumie.
sw.R: Nampenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu hunisikia ninapoomba na kumwomba msaada.

es.L: Amo [a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}], porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} oye mi voz, mis súplicas.
es.B: Amo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escucha cuando {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llamo y le suplico misericordia.
es.R: Amo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me oye cuando oro y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pido ayuda.

vi.L: Tôi yêu [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}], vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghe tiếng tôi, những lời nài xin của tôi.
vi.B: Tôi yêu mến {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lắng nghe khi tôi kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nài xin lòng thương xót.
vi.R: Tôi yêu mến {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghe khi tôi cầu nguyện và xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giúp đỡ.

decisions.choice: I love: the object is left unspoken
alternatives: I love it that the LORD hears
decisions.reason: The verb has no object. The sense is that the psalmist loves the LORD because he heard; it may also mean "I am glad that the LORD hears".

decisions.choice: pleas: cries for mercy
decisions.reason: The word (tachanunim) is a plea for grace or favor (28:2; 86:6).

decisions.choice: the LORD
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply the object of "love" (m1); Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: Amo al SEÑOR (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "I love", leaving the one loved unspoken. Literal supplies "[a él]" in brackets; Balanced and Readable name the LORD, as the English does.

records.literal_gloss: For he has turned his ear to me, and in my days I will call.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has turned {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ear to me, and in my days I will call.
en.B: Because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has turned {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ear toward me, I will call to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} all my days.
en.R: He bends down to listen to me, so I will pray to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} every day of my life.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tendu {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} oreille vers moi, et pendant mes jours j’appellerai.
fr.B: Parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tendu l’oreille vers moi, je {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appellerai tous les jours de ma vie.
fr.R: Il se penche pour m’écouter, alors je {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} prierai chaque jour de ma vie.

sw.L: Kwa maana amenitegea sikio {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, nami katika siku zangu nitaita.
sw.B: Kwa sababu amenigeuzia sikio {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, nitamwita siku zote za maisha yangu.
sw.R: Huinama kunisikiliza, kwa hiyo nitamwomba kila siku ya maisha yangu.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha inclinado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} oído hacia mí, y en mis días clamaré.
es.B: Como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha inclinado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} oído hacia mí, {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} invocaré todos mis días.
es.R: Él se inclina para escucharme, así que oraré a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todos los días de mi vida.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nghiêng tai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến tôi, và trong những ngày [đời] tôi, tôi sẽ kêu cầu.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nghiêng tai về phía tôi, nên trọn đời tôi sẽ kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài cúi xuống lắng nghe tôi, nên tôi sẽ cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mỗi ngày trong suốt cuộc đời.

decisions.choice: turned his ear: listened closely
decisions.reason: To turn or bend the ear is to lean in and listen (17:6; 31:3).

decisions.choice: in my days: as long as I live
decisions.reason: "My days" are the days of his life.

decisions.choice: to him (B); pray to him (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply the one he will call to.

source.text: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי׀חֶבְלֵי־מָ֗וֶת וּמְצָרֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל מְצָא֑וּנִי צָרָ֖ה וְיָג֣וֹן אֶמְצָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: Encircled me [the] cords of death, and [the] distresses of Sheol found me; trouble and sorrow I found.

en.L: The cords of death surrounded me, and the distresses of Sheol found me; trouble and sorrow I found.
en.B: The ropes of death were wound around me, and the anguish of Sheol had caught me; I met with distress and grief.
en.R: It was as if death had tied me up with ropes. I was afraid I would soon be in the place of the dead. I was full of trouble and sorrow.

fr.L: Les liens de la mort m’ont entouré, et les angoisses du Shéol m’ont atteint ; la détresse et le chagrin, je les ai trouvés.
fr.B: Les cordes de la mort s’étaient enroulées autour de moi, et l’angoisse du séjour des morts m’avait saisi ; j’étais dans la détresse et le chagrin.
fr.R: C’était comme si la mort m’avait attaché avec des cordes. J’avais peur de me retrouver bientôt au séjour des morts. J’étais rempli de malheur et de tristesse.

sw.L: Kamba za mauti zilinizunguka, na dhiki za Kuzimu zilinipata; taabu na huzuni nilipata.
sw.B: Kamba za mauti zilinizonga, na maumivu ya Kuzimu yalikuwa yamenikamata; nilikutana na dhiki na majonzi.
sw.R: Ilikuwa kana kwamba mauti imenifunga kwa kamba. Niliogopa kwamba karibu ningeingia Kuzimu, mahali pa wafu. Nilijaa taabu na huzuni.

es.L: Me rodearon los lazos de la muerte, y las angustias del Seol me alcanzaron; angustia y dolor encontré.
es.B: Las cuerdas de la muerte se enrollaban a mi alrededor, y la angustia del lugar de los muertos me había atrapado; me encontré con aflicción y tristeza.
es.R: Era como si la muerte me hubiera atado con cuerdas. Tenía miedo de estar pronto en el lugar de los muertos. Estaba lleno de problemas y de tristeza.

vi.L: Những dây của sự chết đã quấn quanh tôi, và những nỗi khốn quẫn của Âm Phủ đã tìm đến tôi; gian nan và sầu khổ tôi đã gặp.
vi.B: Những sợi dây của sự chết đã quấn chặt lấy tôi, và nỗi thống khổ của Âm Phủ đã bắt được tôi; tôi gặp toàn gian nan và buồn đau.
vi.R: Như thể sự chết đã lấy dây trói chặt tôi. Tôi sợ mình sắp phải vào nơi của người chết. Lòng tôi đầy khó khăn và buồn khổ.

decisions.choice: the cords of death: as in 18:5-6
decisions.reason: The same picture of death as a hunter's ropes appears in 18:5-6. The word (chevel) can mean cords or birth pangs.

decisions.choice: distresses of Sheol: the grip of the grave
decisions.reason: The word (metsarim) is a narrow, tight place; Sheol is the place of the dead (6:6). The psalmist was near death.

decisions.choice: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable explains Sheol.

decisions.choice: "le Shéol" (Literal); "le séjour des morts" (Balanced, Readable), for Psalms 105–118
decisions.reason: Sheol is the place of the dead (meaning decision m2). Literal keeps the name; Balanced and Readable use the French phrase the terms note sets for it, which Readable can also use, since it is plain. "L'enfer" would add the idea of punishment.

decisions.choice: "Kuzimu" for Sheol at every level, with "mahali pa wafu" (the place of the dead) added at Readable
alternatives: "mahali pa wafu" alone at Readable, as the English Readable has
decisions.reason: "Kuzimu" is the settled Swahili name for the world of the dead in these books. Readable keeps it and explains it in the same sentence, so readers learn the word and its meaning together.

decisions.choice: el Seol (L); el lugar de los muertos (B, R)
decisions.reason: Sheol is the world of the dead. As in the other Spanish Psalms and the books of Moses, Literal keeps the name "el Seol" and Balanced and Readable say "el lugar de los muertos".

decisions.choice: "Âm Phủ" (L, B); "nơi của người chết" (R), as Psalm 139:8
decisions.reason: The published Psalm 139 sets these forms for Sheol; the terms note follows it. |

source.text: וּבְשֵֽׁם־יְהוָ֥ה אֶקְרָ֑א אָנָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַלְּטָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: And on [the] name of YHWH I called: Please, YHWH, rescue my soul!

en.L: And on the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I called: Please, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, rescue my soul!
en.B: So I cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} by name: Please, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, save my life!
en.R: So I prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, please save my life!

fr.L: Et le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, je l’ai invoqué : « De grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, délivre mon âme ! »
fr.B: Alors j’ai appelé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom : « De grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sauve ma vie ! »
fr.R: Alors j’ai prié {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, sauve ma vie ! »

sw.L: Nami nililiitia jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: Tafadhali, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, iokoe nafsi yangu!
sw.B: Basi nilimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}: Tafadhali, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uyaokoe maisha yangu!
sw.R: Basi nilimwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, tafadhali uniokoe nisife!

es.L: Y el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} invoqué: ¡Te ruego, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, libra mi alma!
es.B: Entonces clamé {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por su nombre: ¡Por favor, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, salva mi vida!
es.R: Entonces oré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡por favor, sálvame la vida!».

vi.L: Và tôi đã kêu cầu danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: Ôi, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin giải cứu linh hồn tôi!
vi.B: Vì thế tôi gọi danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà kêu cầu: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin cứu mạng sống tôi!
vi.R: Vì thế tôi cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin cứu mạng sống tôi!

decisions.choice: call on the name of the LORD: pray to him
decisions.reason: To call on his name is to pray to the LORD as the God who has made himself known (Genesis 12:8; verses 13 and 17).

decisions.choice: please: an urgent plea
decisions.reason: The word ('anna) is a strong "please!", used in desperate prayer (118:25).

decisions.choice: soul: life
decisions.reason: The word (nefesh) is the self or life (3:3).

decisions.choice: my life
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, nefesh is "my life" where the danger is death.

decisions.choice: "mạng sống tôi" (B, R) for nefesh as life; "linh hồn tôi" (L)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads nefesh here as the singer's life; Literal keeps the terms note's word. |

records.literal_gloss: Gracious [is] YHWH and righteous, and our God [is] compassionate.

en.L: Gracious [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and righteous; and our God [is] compassionate.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} shows grace and does what is right; our God is tender and merciful.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is kind and always does what is right. Our God shows mercy.

fr.L: Plein de grâce [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et juste ; et notre Dieu [est] compatissant.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fait grâce et agit avec justice ; notre Dieu est tendre et plein de pitié.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon et fait toujours ce qui est juste. Notre Dieu a pitié de nous.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwenye neema, na mwenye haki; na Mungu wetu [ni] mwenye huruma.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huonyesha neema na hutenda yaliyo haki; Mungu wetu ni mpole na mwenye rehema.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema, na daima hutenda yaliyo haki. Mungu wetu huonyesha huruma.

es.L: Clemente [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y justo; y nuestro Dios [es] compasivo.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} muestra su gracia y hace lo justo; nuestro Dios es tierno y misericordioso.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es bondadoso y siempre hace lo correcto. Nuestro Dios tiene compasión.

vi.L: Nhân từ [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và công chính; và Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta [là Đấng] thương xót.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban ơn và làm điều công chính; Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta đầy lòng thương xót dịu dàng.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tử tế và luôn làm điều đúng. Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta tỏ lòng thương xót.

decisions.choice: gracious and compassionate: Exodus 34:6
decisions.reason: As in 111:4, the words recall the LORD's description of himself to Moses.

decisions.choice: righteous: he does what is right
decisions.reason: The LORD is righteous (tsaddiq) in that he acts rightly and keeps faith, here by saving the one who called.

source.text: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פְּתָאיִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה דַּ֝לּוֹתִ֗י וְלִ֣י יְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: Guarding [the] simple [is] YHWH; I was brought low, and to me he gave salvation.

en.L: Guarding the simple [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; I was brought low, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saved me.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} keeps watch over people with no defense; when I sank down helpless, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rescued me.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} protects people who cannot protect themselves. When I was weak and helpless, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saved me.

fr.L: Gardien des simples [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; j’étais abaissé, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a sauvé.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} veille sur ceux qui sont sans défense ; quand j’étais à bout de forces, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a délivré.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} protège ceux qui ne peuvent pas se protéger eux-mêmes. Quand j’étais faible et sans aide, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a sauvé.

sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwalinda watu wasio na kinga; nilipoanguka bila msaada, aliniokoa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwalinda watu wasioweza kujilinda wenyewe. Nilipokuwa dhaifu na bila msaada, aliniokoa.

es.L: Guarda a los sencillos {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; fui abatido, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me salvó.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cuida de la gente indefensa; cuando me hundí sin fuerzas, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me rescató.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} protege a las personas que no pueden protegerse a sí mismas. Cuando estaba débil e indefenso, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me salvó.

vi.L: Đấng gìn giữ những người chất phác [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; tôi đã bị hạ xuống thấp, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cứu tôi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} canh giữ những người không có gì tự vệ; khi tôi sa xuống bất lực, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giải cứu tôi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bảo vệ những người không thể tự bảo vệ mình. Khi tôi yếu đuối và bất lực, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cứu tôi.

decisions.choice: the simple: people with no cunning or defense
decisions.reason: The word (peta'im) can mean the foolish (Proverbs 1:22), but here, as in 19:8, it is the open and unprotected, who cannot help themselves.

decisions.choice: I was brought low: weak, at the end of my strength
decisions.reason: The verb (dalal) is to be low or thin, weakened (79:8; 142:7).

decisions.choice: people with no defense (B); people who cannot protect themselves (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the word here (m1).

source.text: שׁוּבִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָ֑יְכִי כִּֽי־יְ֝הוָ֗ה גָּמַ֥ל עָלָֽיְכִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Return, my soul, to your rest, for YHWH has dealt fully with you.

en.L: Return, my soul, to your rest, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has dealt bountifully with you.
en.B: Come back to your rest, my soul, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has treated you with kindness.
en.R: I can rest and be calm again, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has been so good to me.

fr.L: Reviens, mon âme, à ton repos, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a fait du bien.
fr.B: Retrouve ton repos, mon âme, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a traitée avec bonté.
fr.R: Je peux me reposer et retrouver le calme, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a été si bon pour moi.

sw.L: Rudi, nafsi yangu, kwenye mapumziko yako, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekutendea mema kwa wingi.
sw.B: Rudi upumzike, ewe nafsi yangu, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekutendea kwa wema.
sw.R: Naweza kupumzika na kutulia tena, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekuwa mwema kwangu sana.

es.L: Vuelve, alma mía, a tu reposo, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ha colmado de bien.
es.B: Vuelve a tu descanso, alma mía, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ha tratado con bondad.
es.R: Puedo descansar y estar tranquilo otra vez, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha sido muy bueno conmigo.

vi.L: Hỡi linh hồn tôi, hãy trở về sự an nghỉ của ngươi, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đối xử rộng rãi với ngươi.
vi.B: Hỡi linh hồn tôi, hãy trở về chốn nghỉ ngơi, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đối đãi tử tế với ngươi.
vi.R: Tôi có thể nghỉ ngơi và bình tâm lại, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã quá tốt với tôi.

decisions.choice: Return, my soul: the psalmist speaks to himself
decisions.reason: As in 42:6 and 103:1, he addresses his own soul, calling himself back to peace.

decisions.choice: dealt bountifully: done good in full measure
decisions.reason: The verb (gamal) is to deal out fully, here in kindness (13:6; 142:8).

decisions.choice: I can rest
decisions.reason: Readable turns the self-address into a plain statement (m1).

decisions.choice: "Hỡi linh hồn tôi" with "ngươi" for "you" when the singer speaks to himself
decisions.reason: The singer turns to his own soul (see the meaning decision); "ngươi" is the word Vietnamese verse uses when one speaks to oneself or to a thing, as with the sea in Psalm 114:5. Readable speaks plainly in the first person, as the English Readable does. |

source.text: כִּ֤י חִלַּ֥צְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֗י מִ֫מָּ֥וֶת אֶת־עֵינִ֥י מִן־דִּמְעָ֑ה אֶת־רַגְלִ֥י מִדֶּֽחִי׃

records.literal_gloss: For you have rescued my soul from death, my eye from tears, my foot from stumbling.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have rescued my soul from death, my eye from tears, my foot from stumbling.
en.B: You have pulled me back from death, kept my eyes from weeping and my feet from tripping.
en.R: You saved me from dying. You dried my tears and kept me from falling.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as délivré mon âme de la mort, mon œil des larmes, mon pied de la chute.
fr.B: Tu m’as arraché à la mort, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as gardé mes yeux des pleurs et mes pieds du faux pas.
fr.R: Tu m’as sauvé de la mort. Tu as séché mes larmes et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as empêché de tomber.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umeiokoa nafsi yangu na mauti, jicho langu na machozi, mguu wangu na kujikwaa.
sw.B: Umenivuta kutoka kwenye mauti, umeyazuia macho yangu yasilie na miguu yangu isijikwae.
sw.R: Uliniokoa nisife. Ulifuta machozi yangu na kunizuia nisianguke.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has librado mi alma de la muerte, mis ojos de las lágrimas, mis pies del tropiezo.
es.B: Tú me has arrancado de la muerte, has guardado mis ojos del llanto y mis pies de tropezar.
es.R: Tú me salvaste de morir. Secaste mis lágrimas y no dejaste que me cayera.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giải cứu linh hồn tôi khỏi sự chết, mắt tôi khỏi nước mắt, chân tôi khỏi vấp ngã.
vi.B: Ngài đã kéo tôi về từ cõi chết, giữ cho mắt tôi khỏi khóc than và chân tôi khỏi vấp ngã.
vi.R: Ngài đã cứu tôi khỏi chết. Ngài đã lau khô nước mắt tôi và giữ tôi khỏi té ngã.

decisions.choice: you: the psalmist turns to speak to God
decisions.reason: After speaking of the LORD (verses 5-7), he now addresses him directly.

decisions.choice: close to 56:14
decisions.reason: 56:14 has nearly the same words: "you have rescued my soul from death, my feet from stumbling".

decisions.choice: me
decisions.reason: As in 116:4, nefesh is the person's life.

records.literal_gloss: I will walk before YHWH in [the] lands of the living.

en.L: I will walk before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in the lands of the living.
en.B: I will go about my life in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, here in the lands of the living.
en.R: I will go on living, and I will spend my days in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Je marcherai devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans les terres des vivants.
fr.B: Je vivrai ma vie en présence {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, ici, dans les terres des vivants.
fr.R: Je vais continuer à vivre, et je passerai mes jours en présence {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nitatembea mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika nchi za walio hai.
sw.B: Nitaendesha maisha yangu mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hapa katika nchi za walio hai.
sw.R: Nitaendelea kuishi, nami nitazitumia siku zangu mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: Andaré delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en las tierras de los vivientes.
es.B: Viviré mi vida en la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, aquí en la tierra de los vivos.
es.R: Seguiré con vida, y pasaré mis días en la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ bước đi trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong đất của người sống.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ sống trọn đời trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tại đây, trên đất của người sống.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ tiếp tục sống, và tôi sẽ sống những ngày của mình trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

decisions.choice: walk before the LORD: live in his presence and service
decisions.reason: To walk before someone is to live under his eye and in his service (Genesis 17:1; 56:14).

decisions.choice: the lands of the living: this life
decisions.reason: The phrase is the world of the living as against the place of the dead (27:13; Isaiah 38:11).

source.text: הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֲ֝נִ֗י עָנִ֥יתִי מְאֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: I believed, for I spoke: I, I am greatly afflicted.

en.L: I believed, even when I said, I am greatly afflicted.
en.B: I kept my faith even when I said, I am suffering terribly.
en.R: I kept on trusting, even when I said, My suffering is terrible.

fr.L: J’ai cru, même quand j’ai dit : « Moi, je suis très affligé. »
fr.B: J’ai gardé la foi même quand je disais : « Je souffre terriblement. »
fr.R: J’ai continué à avoir confiance, même quand je disais : « Ma souffrance est terrible. »

sw.L: Niliamini, hata niliposema, Mimi nimeteswa sana.
sw.B: Niliendelea kuamini hata niliposema, Ninateseka mno.
sw.R: Niliendelea kutumaini, hata niliposema, Mateso yangu ni makali!

es.L: Creí, aun cuando dije: «Estoy muy afligido».
es.B: Mantuve mi fe aun cuando dije: «Estoy sufriendo terriblemente».
es.R: Seguí confiando, aun cuando dije: «Mi sufrimiento es terrible».

vi.L: Tôi đã tin, ngay cả khi tôi nói: Tôi bị khốn khổ quá đỗi.
vi.B: Tôi vẫn giữ lòng tin ngay cả khi tôi nói: Tôi đau khổ vô cùng.
vi.R: Tôi vẫn tiếp tục tin cậy, ngay cả khi tôi nói: Tôi khổ sở quá!

decisions.choice: I believed, even when I spoke
decisions.reason: The joining word (ki) is hard here. It most likely means "even when": he trusted even while he said how afflicted he was. It may also mean "for" or "therefore".

decisions.choice: quoted in 2 Corinthians 4:13
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the ancient Greek translation, "I believed, therefore I spoke", for his own preaching in the middle of suffering.

decisions.choice: believed: trusted, held firm
decisions.reason: The verb (he'emin) is to trust, to be firm in relying on someone (78:22).

records.literal_gloss: I, I said in my alarm: Every human [is] a liar.

en.L: I said in my alarm, every human [is] a liar.
en.B: In my panic I said, Every human being is false.
en.R: When I was terrified, I said, No one can be trusted!

fr.L: Moi, j’ai dit dans mon trouble : « {{gender:Tout être humain|Tout homme}} [est] menteur. »
fr.B: Dans ma panique, j’ai dit : « {{gender:Tout être humain|Tout homme}} est trompeur. »
fr.R: Quand j’étais terrifié, j’ai dit : « On ne peut compter sur personne ! »

sw.L: Mimi nilisema katika hofu yangu, kila mwanadamu [ni] mwongo.
sw.B: Katika taharuki yangu nilisema, Kila mwanadamu ni mdanganyifu.
sw.R: Nilipokuwa na hofu kubwa, nilisema, Hakuna mtu anayeweza kuaminiwa!

es.L: Yo dije en mi turbación: «Todo ser humano [es] mentiroso».
es.B: En mi pánico dije: «Todo ser humano es falso».
es.R: Cuando estaba aterrado, dije: «¡No se puede confiar en nadie!».

vi.L: Tôi đã nói trong cơn hốt hoảng: Mọi người đều [là] kẻ nói dối.
vi.B: Trong cơn hoảng sợ tôi đã nói: Mọi người đều giả dối.
vi.R: Khi kinh hãi, tôi đã nói: Không ai đáng tin cả!

decisions.choice: alarm: panic, hurried fear
decisions.reason: The verb (chafaz) is to hurry away in fear (31:23).

decisions.choice: liar: one who fails you
decisions.reason: The word (kozev) is a liar, and also something that disappoints, like a stream that runs dry. In his terror he found that no human help could be relied on; only the LORD could. Romans 3:4 echoes the Greek of this line.

decisions.choice: No one can be trusted
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the saying (m2).

records.literal_gloss: What will I return to YHWH, all his benefits [are] on me?

en.L: What shall I give back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [for] all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} benefits to me?
en.B: What return can I make to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} kindness to me?
en.R: What can I give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for all the good things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done for me?

fr.L: Que rendrai-je {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} [pour] tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} bienfaits envers moi ?
fr.B: Que pourrai-je rendre {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} pour toute {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} bonté envers moi ?
fr.R: Que puis-je donner {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} pour tout le bien qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a fait ?

sw.B: Ninaweza kumlipa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nini kwa wema {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote kwangu?
sw.R: Ninaweza kumpa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nini kwa mambo yote mazuri aliyonitendea?

es.L: ¿Qué devolveré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} [por] todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} beneficios para conmigo?
es.B: ¿Cómo podré pagar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} toda {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} bondad conmigo?
es.R: ¿Qué puedo dar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por todas las cosas buenas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho por mí?

vi.L: Tôi sẽ lấy gì đáp lại {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [vì] mọi ơn lành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đối với tôi?
vi.B: Tôi có thể lấy gì đền đáp {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vì mọi ơn lành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dành cho tôi?
vi.R: Tôi có thể dâng gì cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vì mọi điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho tôi?

decisions.choice: benefits: good deeds done for me
decisions.reason: The word (tagmul) is from the verb of verse 7 (gamal): what the LORD has dealt out to him in kindness.

decisions.choice: What will I return: an answer follows
decisions.reason: The question is answered in verses 13-14: he cannot repay, but he can give thanks publicly and keep his vows.

records.literal_gloss: [The] cup of salvations I will lift up, and on [the] name of YHWH I will call.

en.L: The cup of salvation I will lift up, and on the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I will call.
en.B: I will lift high the cup of salvation and call out the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will lift up a cup to thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for saving me, and I will call on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name in prayer.

fr.L: La coupe du salut, je l’élèverai, et le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, je l’invoquerai.
fr.B: J’élèverai bien haut la coupe du salut et j’invoquerai le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je lèverai une coupe pour remercier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de m’avoir sauvé, et je prierai en invoquant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.

sw.L: Kikombe cha wokovu nitakiinua, na jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nitaliitia.
sw.B: Nitakiinua juu kikombe cha wokovu na kulitaja jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitainua kikombe kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kuniokoa, na nitaliitia jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} katika maombi.

es.L: La copa de la salvación alzaré, y el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} invocaré.
es.B: Levantaré en alto la copa de la salvación e invocaré el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Levantaré una copa para dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por salvarme, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llamaré por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre en oración.

vi.L: Chén của sự cứu rỗi tôi sẽ nâng lên, và danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tôi sẽ kêu cầu.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ nâng cao chén cứu rỗi và kêu cầu danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ nâng chén lên để cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vì đã cứu tôi, và tôi sẽ gọi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà cầu nguyện.

decisions.choice: the cup of salvation: a cup raised in thanks
decisions.reason: The cup was probably raised and drunk, or poured out, with the thank offering of verse 17 (Numbers 28:7 speaks of drink offerings). "Salvations" is plural: full rescue.

decisions.choice: a cup to thank the LORD for saving me
decisions.reason: Readable says what the cup is for (m1).

records.literal_gloss: My vows to YHWH I will pay, before, please, all his people.

en.L: My vows to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I will pay, [yes], in the presence of all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people.
en.B: What I promised {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I will carry out, with all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people looking on.
en.R: I will do what I promised {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people will see me do it.

fr.L: Mes vœux {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, je les accomplirai, [oui], en présence de tout {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.
fr.B: Ce que j’ai promis {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, je le ferai, sous les yeux de tout {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.
fr.R: Je ferai ce que j’ai promis {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et tout {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple me verra le faire.

sw.L: Nadhiri zangu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nitazitimiza, [naam], mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote.
sw.B: Yale niliyomwahidi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nitayatimiza, watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote wakitazama.
sw.R: Nitafanya yale niliyomwahidi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote wataniona nikifanya hivyo.

es.L: Mis votos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} cumpliré, [sí], en presencia de todo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo.
es.B: Lo que prometí {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} lo cumpliré, delante de todo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo.
es.R: Cumpliré lo que prometí {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y todo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo me verá hacerlo.

vi.L: Những lời hứa nguyện của tôi với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tôi sẽ trả, [phải], trước mặt cả dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Điều tôi đã hứa nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi sẽ thực hiện trước mặt cả dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ làm điều tôi đã hứa với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và tất cả dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ thấy tôi làm.

decisions.choice: vows: promises made in trouble, kept with an offering
decisions.reason: In danger people promised God an offering if he rescued them (66:13-14; Leviticus 7:16). Keeping the vow publicly, before all his people, was part of giving thanks.

decisions.choice: please: a particle of emphasis
decisions.reason: The small word (na') usually means "please"; here it gives emphasis.

records.literal_gloss: Precious in [the] eyes of YHWH [is] the death of his faithful ones.

en.L: Precious in the eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] the death of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful ones.
en.B: The death of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal ones weighs heavily in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} does not let {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful people die lightly. Their lives are precious to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Précieuse aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] la mort de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles.
fr.B: La mort de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sont fidèles pèse lourd aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne laisse pas mourir {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles sans y prendre garde. Leur vie a beaucoup de prix pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: [Ni] ya thamani machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kifo cha waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Kifo cha watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} waaminifu ni jambo zito machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakubali watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} waaminifu wafe kwa urahisi. Maisha yao ni ya thamani {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.

es.L: Preciosa a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [es] la muerte de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} fieles.
es.B: La muerte de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} fieles pesa mucho a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no deja que {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} fieles mueran como si nada. Su vida es preciosa para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

vi.L: Quý giá trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] cái chết của những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Cái chết của những người trung tín với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là điều hệ trọng trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không coi nhẹ cái chết của những người trung tín với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Mạng sống họ quý giá đối với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: precious: costly, of great worth
alternatives: the death of his faithful ones is a grievous thing to him
decisions.reason: The word (yaqar) is costly, valuable. The LORD does not let the death of his own happen lightly; their blood is precious in his sight (72:14). It does not say he is pleased by their death.

decisions.choice: faithful ones: those bound to him in loyal love
decisions.reason: The word (chasidim) is from chesed: people who are loyal to the LORD (4:4; 30:5).

decisions.choice: weighs heavily (B); does not let ... lightly (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring out the sense of the word here (m1).

source.text: אָֽנָּ֣ה יְהוָה֮ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֪י עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲֽנִי־עַ֭בְדְּךָ בֶּן־אֲמָתֶ֑ךָ פִּ֝תַּ֗חְתָּ לְמוֹסֵרָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Please, YHWH, for I [am] your servant; I [am] your servant, [the] son of your maidservant; you have loosed my bonds.

en.L: Please, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, truly I [am] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant; I [am] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, the son of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} maidservant; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have loosed my bonds.
en.B: Yes, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I belong to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, a servant born to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant woman; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have untied the ropes that bound me.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I really am {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant. I have belonged to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} since I was born, because my mother was {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant too. You have set me free from what held me.

fr.L: De grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car je [suis] {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur ; je [suis] {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, le fils de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} servante ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as détaché mes liens.
fr.B: Oui, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartiens, je suis {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, un serviteur né de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} servante ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as défait les cordes qui me liaient.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je suis vraiment {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur. Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartiens depuis ma naissance, car ma mère était {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} servante, elle aussi. Tu m’as libéré de ce qui me retenait.

sw.L: Tafadhali, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hakika mimi [ni] mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; mimi [ni] mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, mwana wa mjakazi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; umevifungua vifungo vyangu.
sw.B: Naam, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mimi ni {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, mtumishi aliyezaliwa na mjakazi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; umezifungua kamba zilizonifunga.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kweli mimi ni mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. Nimekuwa {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} tangu nilipozaliwa, kwa sababu mama yangu naye alikuwa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. Umeniweka huru kutoka kwa kile kilichonifunga.

es.L: Te ruego, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, de verdad yo [soy] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo; yo [soy] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, hijo de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sierva; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has soltado mis ataduras.
es.B: Sí, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pertenezco como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, siervo nacido de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sierva; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has desatado las cuerdas que me ataban.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, de verdad soy {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo. Desde que nací {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} he pertenecido, porque mi madre también era {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sierva. Tú me has librado de lo que me tenía atado.

vi.L: Ôi, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thật tôi [là] đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; tôi [là] đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, con trai của nữ tỳ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tháo xiềng xích của tôi.
vi.B: Vâng, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đầy tớ sinh ra từ người tớ gái của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cởi những dây trói buộc tôi.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi thật là đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Tôi đã thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} từ khi mới sinh, vì mẹ tôi cũng là người phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài đã giải thoát tôi khỏi những gì trói buộc tôi.

decisions.choice: son of your maidservant: a servant from birth
decisions.reason: A child born to a slave woman in a household belonged to that house from birth (Genesis 17:12). The psalmist has belonged to the LORD all his life (86:16).

decisions.choice: loosed my bonds: freed me from death's ropes
decisions.reason: The bonds are the cords of death of verse 3. The LORD has untied them.

decisions.choice: servant: one who belongs to the LORD
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, 'eved for one of God's servants is "servant".

decisions.choice: "ton serviteur" at every level, Literal included
decisions.reason: When the psalmist calls himself God's servant he names his belonging to God, not slavery, so the word is "serviteur" at every level, as set for Psalms 105–118.

decisions.choice: "mtumishi wako" at every level; "mjakazi wako" (your slave woman) at Literal
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the plain word for a slave woman in "son of your maidservant", a servant born in the household. In the Psalms Swahili says "mtumishi" for ʿeved at every level, Literal included, for God's servants and the psalmist's name for himself; "mtumwa" is kept for slavery itself (Joseph sold, 105:17; the slaves of 123:2).

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ của Ngài" at every level, as Psalm 27:9; "nữ tỳ" (L), "người tớ gái" (B), "người phục vụ" (R) for his mother
decisions.reason: The earlier Psalms keep "đầy tớ" for the singer's name for himself before God. |

source.text: לְֽךָ־אֶ֭זְבַּח זֶ֣בַח תּוֹדָ֑ה וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: To you I will sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and on [the] name of YHWH I will call.

en.L: To {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and on the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I will call.
en.B: I will bring {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} a thank offering and call on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} by name.
en.R: I will offer {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} a sacrifice to thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and I will pray to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: À {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} j’offrirai un sacrifice de reconnaissance, et le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, je l’invoquerai.
fr.B: Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}apporterai une offrande de reconnaissance et j’appellerai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.R: Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}offrirai un sacrifice pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercier, et je prierai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Kwako nitatoa dhabihu ya shukrani, na jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nitaliitia.
sw.B: Nitakuletea sadaka ya shukrani na kumwita {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.R: Nitakutolea dhabihu ya kukushukuru, nami nitamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: A {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} ofreceré sacrificio de acción de gracias, y el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} invocaré.
es.B: A {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} traeré una ofrenda de gratitud e invocaré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por su nombre.
es.R: A {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ofreceré un sacrificio para darte gracias, y oraré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tôi sẽ dâng của lễ cảm tạ, và danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tôi sẽ kêu cầu.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ dâng lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} của lễ tạ ơn và gọi danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà kêu cầu.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ dâng lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một của lễ để cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và tôi sẽ cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

decisions.choice: a sacrifice of thanksgiving: the thank offering
decisions.reason: The thank offering (todah) was a sacrifice eaten with family and friends to give thanks for rescue (Leviticus 7:12-15; 50:14; 107:22).

decisions.choice: call on the name: as in 116:4
decisions.reason: As in 116:4.

records.literal_gloss: My vows to YHWH I will pay, before, please, all his people,

en.L: My vows to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I will pay, [yes], in the presence of all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people,
en.B: What I promised {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I will carry out, with all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people looking on,
en.R: I will do what I promised {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people will see me do it.

fr.L: Mes vœux {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, je les accomplirai, [oui], en présence de tout {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple,
fr.B: Ce que j’ai promis {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, je le ferai, sous les yeux de tout {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple,
fr.R: Je ferai ce que j’ai promis {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et tout {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple me verra le faire.

sw.L: Nadhiri zangu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nitazitimiza, [naam], mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote,
sw.B: Yale niliyomwahidi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nitayatimiza, watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote wakitazama,
sw.R: Nitafanya yale niliyomwahidi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote wataniona nikifanya hivyo.

es.L: Mis votos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} cumpliré, [sí], en presencia de todo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo,
es.B: Lo que prometí {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} lo cumpliré, delante de todo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo,
es.R: Cumpliré lo que prometí {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y todo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo me verá hacerlo.

vi.L: Những lời hứa nguyện của tôi với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tôi sẽ trả, [phải], trước mặt cả dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Điều tôi đã hứa nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi sẽ thực hiện trước mặt cả dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.R: Tôi sẽ làm điều tôi đã hứa với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và tất cả dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ thấy tôi làm.

decisions.choice: the same words as verse 14
decisions.reason: The line repeats verse 14 and here leads into verse 19, which says where the vows will be kept.

decisions.choice: vows: promises made in trouble, kept with an offering
a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The sentence continues into verse 19, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

records.literal_gloss: in [the] courts of [the] house of YHWH, in your midst, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!

en.L: in the courts of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in your midst, Jerusalem. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.B: in the courts of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house, within you, Jerusalem. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.R: I will do it in the courtyards of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple in Jerusalem. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!

fr.L: dans les parvis de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, au milieu de toi, Jérusalem. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.B: dans les parvis de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, en ton sein, Jérusalem. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.R: Je le ferai dans les cours du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, à Jérusalem. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !

sw.L: katika nyua za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, katikati yako, Ee Yerusalemu. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.B: katika nyua za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ndani yako, Ee Yerusalemu. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.R: Nitafanya hivyo katika viwanja vya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Yerusalemu. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!

es.L: en los atrios de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, en medio de ti, Jerusalén. ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!
es.B: en los atrios de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, dentro de ti, Jerusalén. ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!
es.R: Lo haré en los patios del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Jerusalén. ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yah}}!

vi.L: trong các hành lang của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, ở giữa ngươi, hỡi Giê-ru-sa-lem. Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!
vi.B: trong các sân của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, giữa lòng thành, hỡi Giê-ru-sa-lem. Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!
vi.R: Tôi sẽ làm điều đó trong sân đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia}}!

decisions.choice: the courts of the house of the LORD: the temple courtyards
decisions.reason: The people gathered in the open courts around the temple building, where sacrifices were offered (84:3; 100:4).

decisions.choice: your midst, Jerusalem: the city addressed
decisions.reason: At the end the psalmist turns to speak to Jerusalem itself.

decisions.choice: Praise the LORD: Hallelu-yah
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is two words: a plural command, "praise!" (hallelu), and Yah, the short form of the divine name (as in 68:5 and Exodus 15:2). It calls the gathered people to praise. Like the full name, Yah is rendered "the LORD", with Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Readable does not address the city, to keep the sentence plain (m2).
